page.overview:
Who is Mary Jo?

Mary Jo is a major character in Find Player Two!, the third story in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Mary Jo has frizzy brown hair, a large mouth with big teeth, caramel-colored skin, big bright brown eyes, a wide nose, and round cheeks. She is pudgy and six-inches taller than Aimee, as well as physically stronger. Mary Jo usually wears stained jeans and a too-tight T-shirt, and she carries around an overstuffed backpack.

Mary Jo is outspoken and rebellious. She is also bossy, which makes Aimee question their friendship. She also has a fear of abandonment after having been abandoned by her parents, to the point where she carries a backpack with supplies in case she needs to suddenly run away.

Mary Jo has been abandoned by both of her parents and has been in foster care with numerous families. Because of this, she carries around a heavy backpack with all the supplies she’ll need to run away, a secret she has only shared with Aimee. The two hang out at Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza, although Mary Jo prefers it more.
